steps.title: Access Figma Developer Apps
steps.detail: Log in to your Figma account, go to Account Settings, and select the 'My apps' section.
steps.whyHuman: Requires user login to a personal or organizational Figma account.

steps.title: Register Application
steps.detail: Click 'Create a new app', enter your app name, description, and set the Redirect URI provided by Composio or your auth service.
steps.whyHuman: Requires manual entry of app details and redirect URIs in the Figma settings UI.

steps.title: Collect Client Credentials
steps.detail: Save the registration details and record the generated Client ID and Client Secret.
steps.whyHuman: Client secrets are shown once upon creation and must be recorded securely.

config.redirectUriNotes: Enter the Composio callback URL in your Figma app registration under My apps.

review.requiredWhen: No app review is required for standard Figma REST API integrations.
process: Create client app under My apps in Figma settings
Use Client ID and Client Secret directly in your OAuth flow
review.timeline: Figma publishes no official review timeline because standard REST API OAuth apps do not require a review submission.

gotchas.text: Integrations accessing Figma for Government accounts must target api.figma-gov.com instead of api.figma.com.
Figma plugin publishing requirements and review policies are separate from REST API OAuth integrations.

composioHandoff: Navigate to the Composio Dashboard, select Toolkits, and search for Figma.
Choose between Composio Managed OAuth or Custom OAuth2.
If using Custom OAuth2, input the Client ID and Client Secret obtained from Figma My apps.
Save the setup and initiate account connection.

claims.text: Composio supports Composio-managed OAuth, custom OAuth2, and API Key authentication for the Figma toolkit.
Figma REST API app registration is managed under My apps within developer account settings.
The base URL for standard Figma API calls is api.figma.com, whereas Figma for Government uses api.figma-gov.com.
Figma supports OAuth2 authentication alongside personal access tokens and plan access tokens.
Figma plugin publishing guidelines are separate from REST API integration requirements.
Figma does not publish official review timelines or mandatory app review requirements for standard REST API integrations.
claims.note: Documentation provides no information regarding mandatory review submissions or evaluation timelines for REST API apps.
